title: Egypt vs Angola: The match shaking up the opening phase of the quali.
seoTitle: Egypt vs Angola: AFCON 2027 Qualifiers Opening Match
subtitle: The debuts of Hossam Hassan and Aliou Cissé pit experience against renewal
excerpt: On Friday, September 25, Egypt hosts Angola at the Cairo International Stadium. With 2026 World Cup experience and Aliou Cissé's renewal...
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Friday, September 25, Egypt hosts Angola at the Cairo International Stadium in the opening duel of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. The match, scheduled for 4 PM (Brasília time), brings together Egyptian experience post-2026 World Cup and Aliou Cissé's rebuilding phase in Angola.

What changes in your wallet when the Selic rate rises

The clash opens Group B's journey, which also features Malawi and South Sudan. Egypt, having played five matches in the United States, returns with a cohesive group and recent competitive rhythm, while Angola comes off a nine-month break between the 2025 AFCON group stage and June friendlies.

Egyptian strategy: Experience and game control

Hossam Hassan maintains the World Cup base, with players who have already featured in the tournament, such as Yasser Ibrahim and Mostafa Ziko. The absence of Mohamed El Shenawy, Yasser Ibrahim, and Mahmoud Hassan Trezeguet due to injury does not alter the team's core nucleus. The coach relies on a 3-4-1-2 formation, with Emam Ashour as the creative link between the second line and the Salah-Ziko duo.

Angolan renewal: Aliou Cissé's challenge

Cissé, who took over in April 2026, cut names like M'Bala Nzola and Clinton Mata, prioritizing a squad aligned with his philosophy. The group features 16 players acting in European leagues, but the short amount of work on the pitch may limit the implementation of a complex tactical system. The defense features David Carmo and Gaspar Kialonda, while the front line relies on Zito Luvumbo, the main speed weapon.

Balanced history: Four wins and four draws

The duel between Egypt and Angola has been repeated eight times, with four Egyptian victories and four draws. The last encounter, in the 2025 AFCON group stage, ended in a 0-0 draw. Angola's trajectory, having beaten the Central African Republic 3-0 in a friendly, shows defensive solidity but offensive difficulty away from home.

Result expectation: Egyptian victory by a narrow margin

Based on the analyses, the match tends to be low-scoring, favoring Egypt, which seeks to secure a spot in the 2027 AFCON, to be played in Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda. The advantage of playing in Cairo and Hossam Hassan's experience point to a one-goal Egyptian victory, with few goals scored on both sides.

With information from LANCE!, VAVEL.com, SAPO.
